partnership_angle: Referral partner with sandbox-tester entry. AARC-360 is the near-ideal profile: 33-person founder-led boutique, explicitly startup/SaaS-specialized in the Drata directory, already fluent in GRC automation via the Drata Auditor Alliance, and serving 1-300-employee clients — exactly LoxeAI's ICP. Neil Gonsalves learned the audit-referral playbook at A-LIGN, so he understands tools that feed pre-audit clients into his pipeline. Entry motion: get Neil or CRO Jeff Sopshin to run a LoxeAI scan on a sandbox AWS environment (Tester), have the audit team confirm the findings map cleanly to Trust Services Criteria (Validator), then formalize a referral arrangement where AARC-360 points readiness-stage prospects to LoxeAI (Design Partner feeder). The firm already sells its own readiness assessments, so position LoxeAI as the automated pre-readiness layer that qualifies leads for their higher-margin audit work rather than competing with it.
pitch_note: Hi Neil — you built AARC-360 around exactly the SaaS and startup clients we scan for. LoxeAI is an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner for lean startups; before we tell any founder 'this gets you audit-ready,' we want a real auditor to pressure-test it. Would you spend 30 minutes running our scan against a sandbox AWS account? If the findings hold up against your Trust Services mapping, we'd love AARC-360 to be the firm you recommend after clients run the scan — they show up 80% ready, your fieldwork shrinks, and readiness-stage prospects come to you pre-qualified.
